comment: C2 e2e pinned version manifest. Future e2e runs must use this baseline. setup_c2.sh collects OBSERVED versions into $C2/versions.json at the end of every run and diffs them against this file: the monorepo commit and on-chain contract versions are ENFORCED (mismatch aborts; escape hatch SKIP_VERSION_CHECK=1), anvil/go versions warn only, the FISCO-BCOS EL commit is recorded not enforced (it moves with active development).

op_monorepo.note: op-deployer embeds contracts-bedrock forge artifacts (mktar from packages/contracts-bedrock, justfile copy-contract-artifacts semantics) — the monorepo commit therefore pins the deployed contract bytecode too.

l1_contracts.source: embedded contracts-bedrock at the monorepo commit above (pre-U20 form: classic fault games, SystemConfig v3)
l1_contracts.upgrade_policy: stay until op-contracts v8.0.0 FINAL ships AND target superchains execute U20; migrating means rewriting the dispute-game claim flow (super-root games) and SystemConfig v4 breaking changes

el.name: FISCO-BCOS opstack-executor
el.note: any feat-opstack-merged commit >= 5178d86db (runtime MPT persistence) works for e2e; >= 7dbf4da6f needed for eth_getProof flat path; recorded per-run, never enforced

fork_schedule.note: all-zero: Isthmus rules + Jovian extensions active from genesis (withdrawalsRoot slot = MessagePasser storage root; blobGasUsed slot = DA footprint)
